units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 146:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLVI, 5</cite> <he>משמתחתי … והִרְקַעְתִּי הארץ וכ׳</he> since I stretched the heaven and spread the land (over the water), have they ever moved from their position?

senses.gloss: (in enigmatic speech, denom. of רָקִיעַ) to make to look blue.
units: Erub. 53ᵇ הַרְקִיעוּ Ms. M. (ed. אַרְקִיעוּ), v. זָהָב; [Rashi: spread the glowing coals].—[Tosef. B. Bath. XI, 9 שהרקיע ed. Zuck., read: שהִרְקִיב.]
